title: Pier 9: the freezer

panels.shot: Inside the freezer, blue light, frost breath. Marchetti lies against the cash crates, his cleaver frozen into the floor. The hero kneels over him, one hand on the gold necklace.

lines.speaker: Marchetti
lines.text: I just collect... The fire came from below. Switch's rats.

panels.shot: Close-up. A cash crate lid is open. Stacks of bills, each band stamped with an old brass Line 0 metro token.

lines.text: Old metro tokens. The money took the train nobody rides anymore.

panels.shot: Exterior. Sleet turns to rain. The hero walks away from the market. Steam rises from a street grate marked Saint-Ambrose, Ligne 0. Nero waits at the stairs.

lines.text: Saint-Ambrose station. Closed for thirty years. Open for business.

panels.shot: A payphone on the market gate rings. Cut-in: Hale in a phone booth, hat brim low, rain on the glass.

lines.speaker: Hale · phone
lines.text: Switch runs the tunnels. Take a light. And take the dog.
